name: Kings Road zebra crossing, Brentwood (area-inspired)
description: Area-inspired layout of Kings Road (B185), Brentwood, from the High Street junction to just before the Queen's Road roundabout, with its zebra crossing. Not an official test route. Road centrelines, side roads, the crossing, the bus stop and trees from OpenStreetMap; building outlines from OpenStreetMap ("map") and Microsoft machine-detected outlines via Overture Maps ("reference"); lane widths, kerb lines, the give-way lines, zig-zag length, building heights and roof styles are estimated; street lights are representative.
